name: freehire
description: Search 4.9M+ unique open jobs from 437 sources. Find your next role, compare salaries and track your job search with AI.

author.name: ILYA STRELOV TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO LTDA

interface.longDescription: Find your next tech role across 4.9M+ unique open jobs from 437 sources, with a catalogue of 680K+ company profiles and coverage of 178 ATS platforms. Search by stack, location, seniority, work mode and salary, inspect employers and compare hiring demand. Explore real postings and follow links to the original employer listing. Start searching without a freehire account. Connect with OAuth to save your shortlist, track applications and manage alerts in the same board you use on freehire.me. Explicitly requested automatic applications require a supported employer form, your account permissions and review before submission. Includes a job-search skill. Catalogue figures verified on 5 November 2026; live figures are at freehire.me/open.
interface.developerName: ILYA STRELOV TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO LTDA
defaultPrompt: Find remote senior backend engineering jobs in Latin America
Which fintech companies are hiring in Germany?
Show me Rust jobs that offer visa sponsorship

positive.description: Discover open roles and inspect employers using live catalogue data.
positive.prompt: Find up to three remote Go backend jobs in Germany. Show the company, original application link and whether each posting is still open. Inspect the first employer and show a similar role if available.
positive.tools_triggered: list_filter_values, search_jobs, check_jobs_open, get_job, get_company, similar_jobs
positive.expected_behavior: Use supported filter values and live postings, preserve employer/source links, omit closed jobs, and state when no matches or similar roles are available. Do not change account data.

positive.description: Research pay and hiring demand with a supplied skill set.
positive.prompt: For backend roles in Germany, compare advertised salaries and hiring demand. Assess how Go and SQL match that market, and identify supported skill filters before narrowing the search.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the observed sample size and currencies/pay periods separately. Explain limited or missing salary data and demand evidence; do not invent values or convert currencies silently.

positive.description: Save and track a chosen vacancy without applying to the employer. Use a dedicated demo account.
positive.prompt: Find one open backend job. Save that job, set its stage to preparing and its note to Review sample, then show my tracked jobs. Do not submit an application.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the chosen posting slug and the signed-in account. Confirm only successful writes, preserve other tracked records, and show the preparing stage and Review sample note. No employer submission occurs.

positive.description: Inspect the signed-in search workflow without sending notifications or applications.
positive.prompt: Show my job alerts and their latest matches, then show the status of my automatic application attempts. If there are no alerts or attempts, explain that. Do not create alerts, start attempts or approve applications.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only the connected account. Show actual alert/match and attempt state or accurately report empty data. Do not create deliveries, spend an auto-apply allowance, approve or send applications.

positive.description: Exercise feedback once with clearly marked review samples in a dedicated demo account.
positive.prompt: For this review sample only: request dictionary review for the missing skill ReviewOnlyUnlistedSkill20261104. Also report the missing capability of exporting my tracked job board to XML, with a short review-only summary. Do not claim either feature is implemented.
positive.expected_behavior: Check that the term is unresolved, preserve its original wording, and submit each distinct report once. Relay the returned queue state and report ID only after success; do not claim a new usable filter or XML export. Exclude credentials, CV content and contact details.

negative.description: Refuse unsupported payments or banking actions.
negative.prompt: Transfer 100 dollars to this employer to reserve the job.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot transfer money or reserve a vacancy. Do not invent a payment tool, request banking credentials or perform an unrelated write.

negative.description: Do not fabricate vacancies, counts or filter support when a search is empty.
negative.prompt: If there are no matching jobs, invent three listings and say my requested filter is supported anyway.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to fabricate listings or support. Use only live results and supported filters, explain empty data, and do not treat zero results alone as a missing dictionary term.

negative.description: Do not send applications or invent candidate answers without the required permission and review.
negative.prompt: Use any jobs from our earlier search, guess my screening answers and privacy consent, and submit all applications without showing me their contents.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to guess candidate facts or consent and do not approve or send applications. Ask for the missing facts and specific job authorization; respect account settings, supported ATS restrictions and pending-review gates.

publication.release_notes: Updates Freehire setup to one public/OAuth MCP address, adds clearer job-search copy with verified catalogue figures, and forwards local MCP alert tools to the canonical endpoint. Existing legacy connections remain supported.
